entities.summary: Emilie Pine is a writer and lecturer in modern drama at University College Dublin (UCD). Notes to Self is her debut collection of personal essays that brings together six deeply personal pieces on her life, including trauma, family, infertility, and the female body. It was originally published in 2018 and won multiple awards including Irish Book of the Year. Her first novel, Ruth and Pen, followed later in 2022.
